description: VSI COBOL on OpenVMS over ssh/scp. .COB sources in terminal format (what COBOL reads without /ANSI_FORMAT); the compile command goes straight into compile_each. Compile, link, run and results file verified with VSI COBOL V3.1-0007 on OpenVMS V8.4-2L3, with the .COM files run by hand from a terminal. ssh/scp not verified on a real OpenVMS.
